response.query: Which orthogonal PD quantitation methods (capillary immunoassay, phosphopeptide LC‑MS/MS) and specific normalization/acceptance criteria (linearity range, LLOQ, loading controls) will be mandated for p‑AKT Ser473?
response.answer: For p-AKT Ser473 quantitation, capillary immunoassay and phosphopeptide LC-MS/MS are used. Normalization requires linearity range, LLOQ, and protein loading controls.
